name: Steal Me Softly
source:
One moonlit night, you reunite with your rival Wyatt Hennessy and linger for a talk. After all, it's difficult not to tease the detective for all the times he went after you, an infamous phantom thief. 

And maybe, just maybe, you quite missed him too. 

[From [url=https://linglyum.itch.io/steal-me-softly]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个月夜，你与你的竞争对手怀亚特·轩尼诗重聚，并闲聊。毕竟，侦探每次都在追捕你这个声名狼藉的怪盗，很难不去取笑他。

也许，只是也许，你也很想念他。

[来自[url=https://linglyum.itch.io/steal-me-softly]itch.io[/url]]
